about_the_game:
An incest-themed visual novel series with animations, focusing on two sisters who live with their stepbrother and share experiences as they navigate college life away from home. 

GAME DESCRIPTION

In Episode 7, sisters Lily and Emily, joined by their stepbrother Theo, cram into Kevin’s truck and head to a remote mountain cabin.

It’s a weekend getaway: four college students shaking off exam stress with booze and fun.

Looking to spice up the evening by the fire, Lily suggests a game of Truth or Dare.

After a few shots for courage, the game kicks off with some bold dares, just as expected.

But as the night goes on, words like ‘family’ and ‘jealousy’ start to lose all meaning in the heat of the moment.

FEATURES

- HD renders and animations

- Video and image gallery
